name: Kings of the zone
description: Kings stay present through the runtime (kings_runtime.lua) until defeated, then follow the game's own conditions. Every edit is the same length and leaves the natural condition as it was when the switch says no: a script may ask the switch, and where several spawners hold one King the shared flag still decides first, so one King comes. No edit may force a King after its defeat.

kings.note: Spawner thread 29 tests var15 == 1 (thread 30 sets it to 1 or leaves it 0). Same length: var15 OR the rare-game switch. The hook answers yes only until the Lich is defeated; afterwards var15 decides as in the original.
